datasets.name: ds_drift
queryLines: SELECT v.vs_year AS value_set_version, COUNT(DISTINCT o.patient_id) AS patients_with_egfr
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT measurement_year AS vs_year FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_terminology.value_set_segment WHERE segment_id='KED_EGFR') v
LEFT JOIN (SELECT measurement_year AS vs_year, code FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_terminology.value_set_segment WHERE segment_id='KED_EGFR') vs ON vs.vs_year = v.vs_year
LEFT JOIN (SELECT patient_id, loinc_code FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.silver_observation WHERE year(result_ts)=2025) o ON o.loinc_code = vs.code
GROUP BY v.vs_year ORDER BY v.vs_year

datasets.name: ds_drift_kpi
queryLines: WITH d AS (
SELECT v.vs_year AS value_set_version, COUNT(DISTINCT o.patient_id) AS patients_with_egfr
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT measurement_year AS vs_year FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_terminology.value_set_segment WHERE segment_id='KED_EGFR') v
LEFT JOIN (SELECT measurement_year AS vs_year, code FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_terminology.value_set_segment WHERE segment_id='KED_EGFR') vs ON vs.vs_year = v.vs_year
LEFT JOIN (SELECT patient_id, loinc_code FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol.silver_observation WHERE year(result_ts)=2025) o ON o.loinc_code = vs.code
GROUP BY v.vs_year
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN value_set_version='2025' THEN patients_with_egfr END) AS coverage_2025,
MAX(CASE WHEN value_set_version='2026' THEN patients_with_egfr END) AS coverage_2026,
MAX(CASE WHEN value_set_version='2025' THEN patients_with_egfr END) - MAX(CASE WHEN value_set_version='2026' THEN patients_with_egfr END) AS patients_lost
FROM d

datasets.name: ds_drift_codes
queryLines: SELECT measurement_year AS value_set_version, concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(code))) AS egfr_codes
FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_terminology.value_set_segment WHERE segment_id='KED_EGFR'
GROUP BY measurement_year ORDER BY value_set_version

datasets.name: ds_closure
queryLines: SELECT ancestor_code AS diabetes_root, COUNT(DISTINCT descendant_code) AS descendant_codes
FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_terminology.icd10_closure
WHERE ancestor_code IN ('E10','E11','E13') GROUP BY ancestor_code ORDER BY ancestor_code

datasets.name: ds_subsumption
queryLines: SELECT
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT descendant_code) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_terminology.icd10_closure WHERE ancestor_code IN ('E10','E11','E13')) AS cohort_codes,

(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.descendant_code) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_terminology.rxnorm_closure c JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_terminology.rxnorm_statin s ON c.ancestor_code = s.rxcui) AS statin_drugs,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_terminology.rxnorm_statin) AS statin_ingredients

datasets.name: ds_graph
queryLines: SELECT predicate, COUNT(*) AS edges FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.care_protocol_terminology.protocol_edges
GROUP BY predicate ORDER BY edges DESC

widget.name: hdr_drift
widget.textbox_spec:
## Measure drift from terminology — same patients, same lab data, a newer value-set version
KED's eGFR value set was "modernized" for MY2026 (CKD-EPI 98979-8 only), dropping the MDRD code (33914-3) the data actually uses. The measure silently collapses — with a governed, year-versioned value set, that change is explicit instead of invisible.
